slug: 我气运之子反派系统什么鬼
content_zh:
周围昏暗，这是一间密不透风的密室，石壁上雕刻着花纹，透着岁月的沧桑。
空气中弥漫着一股幽香。
甜腻，清冷。
他感觉手里握着什么东西，软软的。
下意识捏了捏。
触感细腻，温软如玉，弹性惊人。
“嗯~”
一声娇柔的轻哼响起，瞬间击溃了他残存的混沌。
猛地转头。
只见一位绝色仙子酣睡于侧。
面容精致绝伦。
肤若凝脂，欺霜赛雪，眉似远山，不描而黛，唇似点绛，娇艳欲滴。
睡梦中，也依旧清冷孤傲，宛如冰山雪莲，神圣而不可亵渎。
只是，此刻的她，不着寸缕，春光乍泄。
完美的曲线一览无余，令人血脉贲张。
大小刚好，只手可握，还很白。
下一瞬，仙子凌清月猛然睁眼。
美眸中，震惊、羞愤、冰冷的杀意交织。
“把手拿开！”
她声音清冷，带着一丝颤抖，显然是强压着怒火。

墨羽立即尴尬收手。
“抱歉，我不是故意的……”
话未说完，凌清月身影消失。
再出现时，已站在数步之外。
衣衫完整，白衣胜雪，纤尘不染，宛如月宫仙子，清冷孤傲。
凌清月低头看着身上的衣物，脑海中浮现昨夜的片段。
误中媚毒，理智尽失，她竟然……
羞耻感席卷全身，清冷的眸子泛起一丝波澜。
身上残留的触感，隐隐的疼痛，都在提醒着她昨夜发生的一切。
她深吸一口气，压下羞耻和愤怒。
事已至此，杀了这人也无济于事。
归根结底，他才是受害者，被用来强行解毒。
“此事，你若敢泄露，我必杀你！”
她丢下这句冰冷的警告，转身欲离。
“仙子，我可以负责！”墨羽叫住她。
凌清月回眸，目光在他身上流转。
容貌俊朗，剑眉星目，气质不凡。
只是，他的修为……
content_en:
The surroundings are dim, this is an airtight secret room, the stone walls are carved with patterns, revealing the vicissitudes of time.
There is a delicate fragrance in the air.
Sweet and refreshing.
He felt something soft in his hand.
I pinched it subconsciously.
It feels delicate to the touch, as warm and soft as jade, and has amazing elasticity.
"Hmm~"
A soft hum sounded out, instantly defeating his remaining chaos.
Turn your head sharply.
I saw a beautiful fairy sleeping soundly on her side.
The face is exquisite.
Her skin is like condensed fat, and the frost beats the snow. Her eyebrows are like distant mountains, and her lips are like a bit of crimson, and they are so delicate and beautiful.
In his sleep, he remained cold and aloof, like an iceberg and snow lotus, sacred and inviolable.
It's just that at this moment, she is completely naked and happily together.
The perfect curves can be seen at a glance, which makes people's blood rush.
It's just the right size, can be held in one hand, and is very white.
The next moment, Fairy Ling Qingyue suddenly opened her eyes.
Shock, shame, anger, and cold murderous intent were intertwined in her beautiful eyes.
"Take your hands away!"
Her voice was cold and trembling, obviously suppressing her anger.
Mo Yu immediately stopped in embarrassment.
"Sorry, I didn't mean to..."
Before he finished speaking, Ling Qingyue disappeared.
When he reappeared, he was already standing several steps away.
The clothes are complete, whiter than snow, spotless, like a fairy in the Moon Palace, cold and aloof.
Ling Qingyue looked down at the clothes on her body, and the fragments of last night appeared in her mind.
She accidentally fell into the poison of charm and lost all her sanity. She actually...
A sense of shame swept through his body, and his cold eyes flashed with waves.
The remaining touch and faint pain on her body reminded her of everything that happened last night.
She took a deep breath, suppressing her shame and anger.
The matter has come to this, and killing this man will not help.
Ultimately, he is the victim, being used to forcibly detoxify.
"If you dare to leak this matter, I will kill you!"
She dropped this cold warning and turned to leave.
"Fairy, I can take responsibility!" Mo Yu stopped her.
Ling Qingyue looked back, her eyes flowing on him.
